task: North Star Screen Parity task 002 (design-docs/plans/active/north_star_screen_parity/tasks/002-welcomepage-cta-placement.md): in frontend/src/pages/Welcome/WelcomePage.tsx, moved the CTA row (primary 'Enter Library' + secondary 'View Documentation') from after the 'Getting started'/'Learn more' sections to immediately after the hero's status chips, matching the demo's splash.tsx layout. Also converted the secondary CTA from a bare `<a href="#">` to a `<button type="button" className="welcome-cta-secondary">` so both CTAs are the same button element family with visually distinct primary/secondary treatment (existing .welcome-cta-secondary outline styling already differed from primary; no new Btn component was introduced since none exists in live code — the 'Btn component' referenced in the task spec is a demo-only mockup component in frontend/src/demo/stages/siteMockup/shared.tsx, not part of live WelcomePage). Corresponding WelcomePage.css rule for .welcome-cta-secondary updated: dropped now-unneeded text-decoration:none (no longer an anchor) and added font-family:inherit (buttons don't inherit font by default). New test file frontend/tests/unit/pages/Welcome/WelcomePage.test.tsx added (no prior WelcomePage test existed) asserting DOM order (hero -> ctas -> getting-started) and that both CTAs render as <button> elements with distinct classNames.
